usdRate.sourceName: World Bank WDI, official exchange rate (PA.NUS.FCRF), United Arab Emirates
usdRate.note: The dirham is pegged at 3.6725 per US dollar.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Federal Competitiveness and Statistics Centre (FCSC) CPI, December 2025, via Trading Economics
inflation_cpi.note: 2.04% year on year in December 2025 (1.61% in November), the latest headline rate shown; secondary source because the FCSC site refused requests. World Bank 2025 average 1.25%.

inflation_projection.sourceName: Dirham pegged to the US dollar; FCSC CPI 2.0% (December 2025); World Bank CPI 1.25% (2025)
inflation_projection.note: With the dirham pegged to the dollar, inflation tracks the US 2% target and averaged about 2% over 2021 to 2025, so 2% is used.

policy_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of the UAE base rate (overnight deposit facility), decision of 28 October 2026, via Trading Economics
policy_rate.note: Held at 3.90% on 28 October 2026 after a 25 basis point rise in September 2026, following the US Federal Reserve. Secondary source because the central bank site refused requests.

savings_account_rate.note: No industry-wide savings account rate could be read; the Central Bank of the UAE site refused requests and web search was unavailable.

fdr_3m_rate.note: No published industry-wide 3-month fixed deposit rate could be read; for reference, 3-month EIBOR was 4.34% on 30 October 2026 (Trading Economics).

fdr_1y_rate.note: No published industry-wide 1-year fixed deposit rate could be read from the Central Bank of the UAE.

dps_rate.note: No industry-wide rate for monthly recurring savings plans was found.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: The Central Bank of the UAE publishes average deposit rates in its statistical bulletin, but its site refused requests; the World Bank has no recent deposit rate for the UAE.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate sold to individuals was confirmed.

tbill_91d_rate.note: The Central Bank of the UAE issues monetary bills to banks, but no current 3-month yield could be read; its site refused requests.

tbond_5y_rate.note: The Ministry of Finance auctions dirham treasury bonds and sukuk through primary dealer banks, but no current 5-year yield could be read.

tbond_10y_rate.note: No current 10-year dirham government bond yield could be read from an official or secondary source.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, United Arab Emirates, taxes on personal income (last reviewed 9 September 2026)
tax_bank_interest.note: There is no personal income tax in the UAE, so interest earned by individuals is untaxed.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, United Arab Emirates, taxes on personal income (last reviewed 9 September 2026)
tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No personal income tax, so returns on any government security held by an individual are untaxed.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: No explicit deposit insurance scheme or cover amount was confirmed for UAE banks; the Central Bank of the UAE site refused requests.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap or published typical credit card rate could be read from the Central Bank of the UAE.

equity_return_low.sourceName: ADX General index 9,466 on 30 October 2026, down 6% in a year and 12% below its February 2026 peak (Trading Economics)
equity_return_low.note: Low case: equities earn about the deposit rate, as in the past year's decline.

equity_return_base.sourceName: ADX General index record (Trading Economics); EIBOR 4.34% and untaxed interest
equity_return_base.note: Base case: about 3.5 points over the untaxed 3-month EIBOR of about 4.3%, within the 4-point cap; the ADX roughly doubled since 2016 with dividends of about 4%.

equity_return_high.note: High case: price growth like 2016-2026 plus dividends.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Dirham pegged at 3.6725 per US dollar
gold_return_low.note: Low case: flat dollar gold; the peg adds no currency gain.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Dirham pegged at 3.6725 per US dollar; long-run dollar gold trend about 4%
gold_return_base.note: Base case: the long-run dollar gold trend, since the peg means no currency effect.

gold_return_high.sourceName: Dirham pegged at 3.6725 per US dollar; dollar gold history
gold_return_high.note: High case: a strong decade for dollar gold.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: Central Bank of the UAE base rate 3.9% (October 2026); no income tax (PwC)
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: US and UAE rates fall back and savings balances earn less than fixed deposits.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: Base rate 3.9%; 3-month EIBOR 4.34% (October 2026); no income tax (PwC)
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: fixed deposits a little below interbank rates over a full rate cycle, untaxed.

fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: rates stay near today's level and savers use longer fixed deposits or government sukuk.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: No industry-wide life claim settlement ratio could be read from the Central Bank of the UAE, the insurance supervisor.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life is sold, but no published premium rates per AED 1,000 by age were found from the regulator or another public source.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical cost of a major private hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: The federal basic health plan for private-sector and domestic workers costs AED 320 a year for ages 1 to 64 (u.ae, updated 8 September 2026), but its annual cover limit and premiums for wider plans by age were not published, so a per-AED-100,000 table could not be built.

oop_health_share.sourceName: World Bank WDI, out-of-pocket expenditure (% of current health expenditure), United Arab Emirates
oop_health_share.note: 9.7% in 2023 (WHO Global Health Expenditure Database via the World Bank); older than 2025, the latest available.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: FCSC health CPI index 103.4 (June 2026, Trading Economics); inflation assumption 2%
goal_inflation_health.note: The health CPI has risen slowly, but private medical costs and insurance premiums have grown faster than general prices, so health goals are planned 2 points above the general assumption.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: FCSC education CPI index 104.5 (June 2026, Trading Economics); inflation assumption 2%
goal_inflation_education.note: Private school fees, regulated by emirate authorities, rise in yearly steps above general inflation, so education goals use 3.5%.

life_expectancy.sourceName: World Bank WDI, life expectancy at birth, total (SP.DYN.LE00.IN), United Arab Emirates
life_expectancy.note: 83.1 years in 2024 (men 82.2, women 84.3); the resident population is mostly working-age migrants.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant for 2026; the 65 total is published there, the other totals are the mean of men and women.

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 2.18 (2025, World Bank), about 3.4 (2040, from 2.7% aged 65+ and 17.9% under 15 on populationpyramid.net/united-arab-emirates/2040/) and 6.8 (2065). Migrant workers keep the ratio high.

retirement_age_default.sourceName: UAE Government portal, Pensions and social security for UAE citizens (updated 14 October 2026)
retirement_age_default.note: Applies to UAE and GCC nationals only: 60 with 15 years of insured service for those registered before 31 October 2023 (most people born after 1975); first-time workers since then may retire from 55 with at least 30 years. Expatriates have no public pension and receive an end-of-service gratuity instead.

retirement_age_government.note: The mandatory retirement age for federal government employees under the federal human resources law could not be read; the GPSSA pension rules above apply to nationals in both sectors.

retirement_return_low.note: Low case: rates fall back over retirement.

retirement_return_base.note: Base case: fixed deposits below today's interbank rate, untaxed, so not above the after-tax safe rate.

retirement_return_high.note: High case: rates stay near today's level.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case: a balanced mix earning about the deposit rate.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Fixed income base 3.5%; equity base 7.5%; gold base 4%
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: a balanced mix of deposits, UAE or global equities and gold.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: Federal and emirate social welfare programmes give means-tested support to low-income UAE nationals (Ministry of Community Empowerment), but no age-based monthly amount for older people is published on the government portal (updated 8 July 2026).

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Social welfare for nationals is means-tested by family situation and income; no separate age-based eligibility rule for older people was found on the government portal.

gratuity_rule.sourceName: UAE Government portal, End of service benefits for workers in the private sector (updated 15 October 2026)
gratuity_rule.note: Workers with at least one year of continuous service get 21 days of last basic wage per year for the first 5 years and 30 days per year after, capped at 2 years' wage (applies to non-national private-sector workers; nationals are in the GPSSA pension). The page gives no daily-wage divisor; 30 days a month is used as the planning convention and is not confirmed. Employers may opt into an approved savings scheme instead.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: UAE Government portal, Pensions and social security for UAE citizens (updated 14 October 2026)
public_pension_scheme.note: GPSSA covers UAE and GCC nationals only (Abu Dhabi nationals: Abu Dhabi Pension Fund); expatriates get an end-of-service gratuity instead. Registration at 18 to 60; pension at 60 with 15 years for those registered before 31 October 2023 (Federal Law 7 of 1999), or from 55 with 30 years for first-time workers since then (Decree-Law 57 of 2023); contributions 26% (employee 11%, employer 15%). The page mentions no automatic indexation, so inflationLinked is set false (not confirmed); pensions are untaxed because there is no personal income tax (PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries).

dps.note: Some banks offer monthly instalment savings accounts; no standard product.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals was confirmed.

tbill_91d.note: Issued by the Central Bank of the UAE to banks, not sold directly to individuals.

tbond_5y.localNameEn: Federal treasury bonds and sukuk (T-Bonds, T-Sukuk)
tbond_5y.note: Dirham bonds auctioned by the Ministry of Finance through primary dealer banks since 2022; retail access is through banks.

tbond_10y.note: Longer dirham maturities are auctioned in smaller amounts (availability not confirmed for every year); retail access is through banks.

equity_fund.note: Funds are regulated by the Securities and Commodities Authority.

gold.note: Gold bars, coins and jewellery are widely sold.

insuranceRegulator.name: Central Bank of the UAE, insurance supervision

insuranceComplaints.name: Sanadak, UAE financial ombudsman for banking and insurance

pensionScheme.name: General Pension and Social Security Authority (GPSSA), for UAE and GCC nationals
pensionScheme.note: Abu Dhabi nationals are covered by the Abu Dhabi Pension Fund; expatriates receive an end-of-service gratuity instead.

oldAgeAllowance.name: Social welfare programmes, Ministry of Community Empowerment (means-tested, UAE nationals)

publicHealthCover.name: Mandatory health insurance by emirate; Thiqa and Enaya for nationals
